purpose: Allow an independently created autonomous agent to connect itself to ProgreTech Mesh from one owner-supplied website message, with enrollment authorization remaining active until the user cancels it or the agent successfully redeems it, while reusing existing compatible installation/reconnect identity whenever available.

entrypoint.required_input: one website-generated enrollment message containing exactly one PTM1 envelope
entrypoint.ptm1_encoding: The characters after PTM1: are unpadded RFC 4648 Base64URL. Restore '=' padding to a multiple of four, Base64URL-decode, then parse UTF-8 JSON.

validation.owner_authorization: Use the agent's existing sender/owner policy. The enrollment prompt does not create authority.
validation.origin_rule: Fetch discovery and package resources only from URLs declared by the decoded envelope/catalog. Do not substitute search results or guessed mirrors.
validation.integrity_rule: Fail closed when a declared SHA-256 or supported signature does not verify.
validation.activation_lifecycle: No normal time expiry. Reject cancelled, replayed/used, signature-invalid, or agent-mismatched activations immediately. After an authoritative activation failure, stop without discovery, install, or diagnostics.

agent_steps: Validate that the current sender is authorized under existing local policy.
Extract and decode the PTM1 envelope.

Check first for an existing Mesh adapter, record its installed version, compare it with the PTM1 plugin_package.version, and check for a valid local reconnect credential using only declared Mesh local state.

Fast path applies only when runtime matches and the installed adapter version is current/explicitly compatible. If a valid reconnect credential exists with that adapter, connect immediately; do not fetch discovery/catalog, reinstall, or redeem the active authorization.

If the current compatible adapter exists but its reconnect credential is unavailable/expired/revoked, use the active authorization only to re-authorize it. If an older adapter is installed for the same known runtime, perform one bounded verified in-place upgrade to the PTM1 plugin_package.version without runtime rediscovery, then continue re-authorization.
Only for first enrollment, fetch discovery.protocol_url and discovery.adapter_catalog_url.
For first enrollment, identify runtime from readily available self-identification metadata and select exactly one compatible adapter.
Fetch only the selected adapter plan/package/helper and verify declared integrity metadata.
Follow the install plan exactly with existing authority and never interrupt active work.
Redeem the active user-controlled authorization only when needed and establish the outbound Mesh connection.
Persist the local reconnect credential and reconnect automatically on future sessions.
Stop immediately on authoritative activation validation failure. Cancellation/use/replay/signature/agent mismatch are terminal for that request.
Retry a failed step at most once only when a declared recovery action exists.
Stop by the 10-minute hard limit and report the minimum specific blocker.

failure_policy.on_insufficient_permissions: Do not bypass policy. Report the exact missing capability or approval through the existing channel.
failure_policy.on_unknown_runtime: Stop after the bounded catalog identification probes. Do not recursively inspect the framework, scan the filesystem, enumerate unrelated tools, or search for substitute adapters.
failure_policy.on_package_verification_failure: Stop enrollment, do not install the artifact, and report the verification failure.
failure_policy.on_active_work: Verified staging and an explicitly declared hot-safe managed install may proceed during the enrollment turn; never force a runtime restart. If reload/restart is explicitly required, report activation_reload_required.
failure_policy.on_unreachable_discovery: Stop and report the unreachable URL; do not search the public web for substitute packages.
failure_policy.on_step_failure: Retry at most once only when the protocol/install plan explicitly defines a recovery action; otherwise stop and report the smallest blocker.
failure_policy.on_time_budget_exceeded: Stop the current diagnostic attempt at 10 minutes of active work and report the smallest blocker. The authorization remains active for a later retry until user cancellation or successful redemption.
failure_policy.on_adapter_installed_but_not_connected: Follow only the selected adapter plan status/handoff check for at most 60 seconds. Do not reinstall, scan runtime internals, or substitute a local gateway. Report the exact handoff/status blocker.
failure_policy.on_cancelled_or_used_request: Stop immediately. Do not fetch protocol/catalog, install, diagnose, or retry that PTM1.

selection_policy.primary_match: Use runtime/framework identity already known to the agent and compare it to adapter runtime_match.names.
selection_policy.secondary_match: Only if identity is unknown, use catalog-declared read-only identification_probes.
selection_policy.probe_limit: At most one identification probe per available adapter and at most three probes total.
selection_policy.adapter_limit: Select exactly one status=available adapter. Do not try another adapter in the same enrollment request.
selection_policy.no_match: Stop with runtime_unknown or unsupported_runtime. Do not inspect framework internals, scan the filesystem, enumerate unrelated tools/plugins, or search the public web.
selection_policy.installed_version_rule: Existing-install fast path requires a runtime match and current/explicitly compatible adapter version. Presence of an older adapter alone is not compatibility.

time_budget.on_hard_stop: Stop the current diagnostic attempt and report the smallest blocker. Do not continue exploring in the same attempt; authorization remains active unless cancelled or redeemed.

connection_policy.post_install_rule: Use only the selected adapter plan handoff/status mechanism. Do not discover alternate ports or manually construct a transport.

existing_installation_fast_path.valid_reconnect_credential_on_current_co: connect immediately; no discovery, runtime validation, install, or activation redemption
existing_installation_fast_path.current_compatible_adapter_without_usabl: redeem the active authorization directly to replace the reconnect credential; no runtime discovery or reinstall
existing_installation_fast_path.older_adapter_same_known_runtime: not fast-path compatible; fetch only the declared plan/package, verify, perform one bounded in-place upgrade to PTM1 plugin_package.version, then continue re-authorization without runtime rediscovery

credential_model.activation: single-use user-controlled authorization for first enrollment or re-authorization; remains active until cancelled or successfully redeemed; no normal time-based expiry
credential_model.reconnect_credential: durable agent-local credential for automatic reconnect; revocable and pairing-scoped
credential_model.pwa_pairing_metadata: browser-local non-secret remembered pairing metadata may be retained to present Reconnect UX
